title: AI IDE Repair Validation-Only Real Campaign Validation v0.1
objective: Validate repair:execute --validation-only consumption of a real or near-real repair handoff package against a controlled target repo, proving verification commands can produce actionable evidence without applying patches or automatically changing target repository files.
acceptance: Use a controlled near-real target repo fixture that contains no private source code.
Consume an existing repair-handoff-package.json through repair:execute --validation-only.
Run bounded verification commands and capture passed, failed, and skipped evidence.
Prove validation-only execution does not apply patches, create commits, create pull requests, mark acceptance passed, or write target repository source files.
Update operations docs, testing strategy, acceptance checklist, decision log, dev log, and progress snapshot.
result_summary: Validated repair:execute --validation-only consumption of a near-real repair handoff package. Runnable commands now produce passed and failed evidence, placeholder/manual checks are recorded as skipped, sensitive output is redacted, and target repository source files remain unchanged.
